assets.displayName: Labeled World Atlas — Alpha 0.6D Canonical Navigation Master
assets.visualAnchor: User-approved labeled world atlas used as the sole active navigation painting for Alpha 0.6D.
assets.notes: Exact supplied labeled map, deterministically resampled and projection-normalized to 6000x4000 for the locked 120x80 world grid. No generative geography changes. Passability is versioned separately in WORLD_TERRAIN_MASK_V06D_LABELED and must remain calibrated to this atlas.

Geometry remains authoritative and versioned separately.
